title: Moodle 4.2.0 through 4.5.15, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, and 5.3.0 contain a…
description: Moodle versions 4.2.0 through 4.5.15, 5.0.0 through 5.0.11, 5.1.0 through 5.1.8, 5.2.0 through 5.2.4, and 5.3.0 have a vulnerability in the core_grades_get_gradeitems web service. This flaw allows authenticated course users to view grade items that are intended to be hidden from them by bypassing capability checks. The vulnerability exposes hidden grade item IDs, names, and categories via AJAX or mobile web service calls.
